source.quote_free_summary: When a division needs several heats, the size difference between heats 'should be no more than 1', including co-mingled contestants.

requirement: A UCWDC profile should balance multi-heat divisions to within one contestant; advisory ('should').
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Advisory/conditional language: tracked as a compliance gap, NOT a mandatory hard blocker, and must not be enforced as one. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: 'should' means recommended, not mandatory; do not enforce as a blocker. Studio's 10D floor planner is first-fit and can produce 8 and 1 for nine entries; the readiness heatPlanner balances to within one (OD25-DF-0002). Neither is claimed as UCWDC compliance.
decision_refs: OD-25 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now for Studio/Custom heat planning; Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
